what_it_is: The iFuse TORQ 3D Printed Porous Titanium SI Screw receives an excellent average rating of 5/5. Surgeons praise its effective compression across the joint and the enhanced traction and stability provided by the 3D printed screws, resulting in positive outcomes in SI fusions. No negative aspects were highlighted in the reviews.
indications: Minimally invasive surgical fusion of the sacroiliac (SI) joint.
use_notes: Sheep model histology (6-week) showed 11.5 Nm max torque-out for iFuse TORQ vs 0.5 Nm for traditional screws (Technical Study 300940-TS). STACI trial: prospective multicenter study demonstrating safety and effectiveness.
